test_cases.query: Which active portfolios with High target risk have a 1-year total return exceeding 20%, and what is their current AUM and Sharpe ratio?
test_cases.sql:
SELECT 
    p.portfolio_name,
    p.total_aum,
    pp.sharpe_ratio
FROM portfolios p
JOIN portfolio_performance pp ON p.portfolio_id = pp.portfolio_id
WHERE LOWER(p.status) = 'active'
  AND LOWER(p.target_risk_level) = 'high'
  AND pp.total_return_1y > 0.20
GROUP BY p.portfolio_id, p.portfolio_name, p.total_aum, pp.sharpe_ratio;

test_cases.query: What is the Bitcoin allocation and fund manager for the Quantum Crypto Arbitrage Fund?
